pattern: join, filter, count and sum two columns per group
question: how many schools in each block have no electricity and how many children studied in them in 2024
gold_sql: SELECT e."Block", COUNT(*) AS schools_without_electricity, SUM(e."Girls 2024" + e."Boys 2024") AS students_2024 FROM school_enrolment_by_year AS e JOIN school_infrastructure AS i ON e."School Code" = i."School Code" WHERE i."Electricity" = 'No' GROUP BY e."Block" ORDER BY e."Block"
sql_duckdb: WITH school_inf_no_elec AS (SELECT "School Code" FROM "school_infrastructure" WHERE "Electricity" = 'No'), school_enrolment_2024 AS (SELECT "School Code", "Block", "Girls 2024", "Boys 2024" FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" WHERE "School Code" IN (SELECT "School Code" FROM school_inf_no_elec)) SELECT s2."Block", COUNT(DISTINCT s2."School Code") AS schools_no_electricity, SUM(s2."Girls 2024") + SUM(s2."Boys 2024") AS total_children_2024 FROM school_enrolment_2024 AS s2 GROUP BY s2."Block"
